title: Outstanding Oily French Broad Beans Pot Au Feu
description: A sour and silky French dish featuring broad beans, spherified for an adventurous twist, suitable for ovo-vegetarian diets.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot and blanch the broad beans for 5 minutes.
Shock the broad beans in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Mix the sodium alginate with a small amount of water to create a solution.
Soak the broad beans in the sodium alginate solution for at least 30 minutes.
Create a spherification bath by mixing the vegetable broth with the egg.
Drop the broad beans into the spherification bath and let them cook for 2 minutes.
Remove the broad beans from the spherification bath with a slotted spoon.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the spherified broad beans to the pan and toss to coat with the sauce.
